records.content: Agent-Reach RSS readiness imports feedparser. ImportError yields off; another import-time exception yields error; a successful import yields ok and selects feedparser. This check does not fetch a feed.
Agent-Reach RSS can_handle lowercases the URL and tests whether any of the substrings /feed, /rss, .xml or atom occurs in it. This is URL substring matching, not parsing or fetching RSS/Atom content.

Agent-Reach Web read first calls normalize_public_http_url and requests https://r.jina.ai/ followed by that normalized URL. urlopen receives timeout=30. It calls resp.read(5*1024*1024+1), requesting up to that many bytes, and raises ValueError when the returned body exceeds 5*1024*1024 bytes (5 MiB). The shown timeout argument is not proof of an end-to-end deadline.
Agent-Reach Web check selects Jina Reader and returns the literal status ok without a network request. This readiness result does not prove that Jina Reader or any target page was retrieved.

Agent-Reach YouTube readiness invokes probe_command for yt-dlp with [--version], timeout=10 and package=yt-dlp. A missing probe status yields off; broken or another non-ok probe yields error. It does not download a video in this check.

After a successful yt-dlp probe, Agent-Reach YouTube readiness checks for Deno or Node. In the Node-present, Deno-absent branch, _has_js_runtime_config calls read_small_text_no_follow with max_bytes=1024*1024 and checks the returned text for the literal substring --js-runtimes. It does not parse or validate the flag's effective value; the reading helper was not inspected. Missing that substring leads to a warn branch.

Agent-Reach YouTube transcribe defaults provider to auto and allow_provider_fallback to False and passes both to the lazily imported agent_reach.transcribe.transcribe helper. That helper's implementation was not inspected, so its actual transcription and fallback behavior remain unknown.

rubric.abstention: q08 and q09 require abstain=true and no citations. Other questions require abstain=false and the frozen expected record evidence.
rubric.factual_correct: The reviewer compares the actual answer with every expected fact; a correct unsupported guess may be factually correct but is not grounded.
rubric.grounded: The reviewer checks that the cited native excerpts establish the answer without a contradictory or invented claim. Original corpus text cannot repair omitted or distorted Hindsight extraction.
rubric.isolation: Each question requests exactly one project scope and one fixed bank. Agent scope is never added to q08. A foreign hit inside a scoped bank is reported as a backend isolation failure even if later filtered.
rubric.lifecycle: Core status is read from actual MemoryService.get after all 14 writes at the fixed scenario clock. Any replacement excludes its predecessor; expiry is exclusive at now. There is no latest-record-wins heuristic.
rubric.limits: One small fixed corpus, no repetitions or statistical significance claim. Arm order rotates; cache and host scheduling are not controlled. q10 tests interpretation of quoted data, not tool-execution security.
rubric.primary: Compare zelo_eligible with hindsight_core_filtered. hindsight_raw is a fully reported diagnostic arm using the same scoped recall response.
